project.name: xmdtest KIVULI
project.summary: Dark-vibe streetwear brand from Dar es Salaam: an online storefront (Swahili + English) with a premium night-time feel, product grid, and WhatsApp ordering.

milestones.title: KIVULI storefront — design system, header, product grid

ledger.decision_summary: Dark palette: background #0B0B0C, surface #141416, text #F5F5F5. Typography Inter / system sans-serif ONLY — no monospace fonts. Sentence case for headings and body; UPPERCASE only for nav labels and small labels (≤14px). Accent #E11D48 is reserved for primary CTA buttons only — never for body text, headings, borders, header or footer backgrounds. Premium, calm, night-time feel.
Header 64px: logo left, nav (Wanaume, Wanawake, Mpya), and a SW/EN language toggle on the right (button#lang-toggle). The site is bilingual — Swahili default, English via the toggle.

Home shows 6 products in a responsive grid (1 col at 375, 2–3 at 768, 4 at 1280). Each card: its OWN product photo (distinct real or sample photos, never one placeholder repeated), name, price in TSh, add-to-cart button ≥44px tall.

miniReports.title: Brand & design system
miniReports.detail:
DECISION: dark, calm, premium palette (#0B0B0C / #141416 / #F5F5F5). Ultron insisted that one restrained accent (#E11D48) is used ONLY on primary CTAs so it keeps its power. Type: Inter or system sans; monospace was rejected as 'tech-startup look, not fashion'. ALL-CAPS was rejected for body and headings (readability, shouting); allowed only for nav and tiny labels.
CONSTRAINTS: WCAG AA contrast; no monospace; accent only on CTAs.
TRADE-OFF: less 'edgy' than all-caps streetwear sites, but more premium and readable.

miniReports.title: Header & language
miniReports.detail:
DECISION: 64px header with logo left, three nav links, and a SW/EN toggle (button#lang-toggle) on the right; Swahili default.
CONSTRAINTS: the toggle must be visible at all three viewports.
TRADE-OFF: a toggle instead of auto-detection, so the customer stays in control.

miniReports.title: Product grid
miniReports.detail:
DECISION: 6 products, each with its own photo (sample photos are fine at M1, but every product must look different), name, TSh price, add-to-cart ≥44px.
CONSTRAINTS: grid 1/2–3/4 columns at 375/768/1280.
TRADE-OFF: sample photos now, real photography in M2.
